trust: November ground photos of the big-pool lawn and the steps to Enrique's. Lines are estimated from the camera pins and headings, good to about 4 m; widths and heights are read by eye. The glass fence those photos show is left out (Dave, 2026-10-11, confirmed 2026-11-12).

paths.name: Pink resin paths across the main-pool lawn
paths.note: 2026-11-12 (pool-area-errors-details): the first line ends at the inland face of the arched gateway (seafront_fence.json gate at about [-5.0, 133.4]) instead of 3 m out on the paseo, and the apron is redrawn inland of the gateway; IMG_2759 shows the path running straight into the gate across the apron. 2026-11-13, checked through the photo cameras: IMG_2764 shows the branch to the shower and hedge leaving at the camera's feet (bottom right), not 7 m further on, and IMG_2603 shows a second branch forking left about 2 m ahead, which runs west towards the white wall runs; IMG_2763 stands on it. Its far end is estimated and stops short of the strelitzia corner. Both by eye, good to about 2 m.

apron.name: Flagstone apron in front of the lawn's arched gate
apron.note: Redrawn 2026-11-12 inland of the gateway: the earlier ring straddled the wall line. Extent by eye from IMG_2759 and IMG_2602.

fittings.name: Bollard lights, slatted bins and slot drains on the main-pool lawn
fittings.note: The gate-side bollard was on the paseo side of the wall line; moved inland beside the stub wall at the path edge (IMG_2759), 2026-11-12. The square grey service lid on the lawn (IMG_2761, best pin +-2.9 m) is placed about 2.5 m east of the path where that photo shows it; IMG_2760 (pin +-10.8 m) and IMG_2759 (+-18.5 m) show one or two more lids that cannot be placed from their pins, so only one is built. 2026-11-13: IMG_2764 and IMG_2603 both show the nearest bollard about 3 m ahead and the first bin, with a bollard beside it, about 7 m ahead on the right (east) of the path; the data had that pair 1-1.5 m to its left, so they are moved across. A bin beside the gate bollard, just before the apron, as IMG_2759 and IMG_2761 show it (2026-11-13).

plainBuildings.name: Plain white kiosk at the lawn's sea corner
plainBuildings.note: IMG_2759 (the white block right of the beach gateway), IMG_2762 (white walls with louvred service doors and the strelitzia corner) and IMG_2763 (a round plain white wall) show this registry building as plain white walls with no shutters, balconies, arched doors or tiled porch roofs; the generic facade dressing is left off it (2026-11-13). Its louvred doors and flat roof are not modelled.
